title: Binance resumes withdrawals following $6.3 billion hack, says 90% of stolen user assets are covered
summary_full: Binance says it has restored backing for 90% of assets affected by its $6.3 billion hack and resumed phased withdrawals.
summary_public: Binance says it has restored backing for 90% of assets affected by its $6.3 billion hack and resumed phased withdrawals.
